title: Cell Line Maintenance and Information Protocol
author: Philippa R Kennedy
materials: All cells are maintained in humidified incubators at 37°C, 5% CO 2 , unless otherwise specified. All cells are routinely tested for mycoplasma infection using a PCR-based test (Universal Mycoplasma Detection Kit, ATCC Cat. No. 30-1012K) Dates of purchase are provided. Aliquots of purchased cells lines are frozen at P0, P1 and P2 from original stocks and P2 are defrosted and used for experimentation as standard. Cell lines confirmed by short tandem repeat analysis are marked with *.

steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: Make the basal media listed below and add antibiotics or selection agents only where specified.

substeps.instruction: R10 medium: use for all lines indicated as grown in R10.
D10 medium: use for all lines indicated as cultured in D10.
D10 + Glutamax: add Glutamax to D10 for lines noted as grown in D10 with Glutamax.
D10‑Glut: same as D10 + Glutamax for lines listed as grown in D10‑Glut.
Add blasticidin 10 µg/mL to R10 when culturing HAY‑luciferase/GFP (selection of GFP/luciferase).
Add blasticidin 2 µg/mL to R10 when culturing NCI‑H2373‑GFP/luciferase (selection of GFP/luciferase).

steps.title: Maintain pleural epithelioid lines
steps.instruction: Culture each pleural epithelioid mesothelioma line in the indicated medium and split at the specified ratio and frequency.

substeps.instruction: NCI‑H2452 (RRID:CVCL_1553) – obtained from Daniel Vallera in 2009; culture in R10 (no split ratio provided).
NCI‑H226 (RRID:CVCL_1544) – obtained from Daniel Vallera in 2009; culture in R10 (no split ratio provided).
NCI‑H2461‑GFP/luciferase (gift of Manish Patel) – grow in R10; split 1/20 twice per week.
YOU (RRID:CVCL_N819; gift of Raffit Hassan, 2021) – grow in R10; split 1/4 twice per week.
HAY (RRID:CVCL_N813; gift of Raffit Hassan, 2021) – grow in R10; split 1/4 twice per week.
HAY‑luciferase/GFP (created by Blake Jacobson, 2021) – grow in R10 containing 10 µg/mL blasticidin; split ratio not specified (maintain under selection).
ORT (RRID:CVCL_N815; gift of Raffit Hassan, 2021) – grow in R10; split 1/2 twice per week.
ROB (RRID:CVCL_N818; gift of Raffit Hassan, 2021) – grow in R10; split 1/4 twice per week.
PET (RRID:CVCL_N816; gift of Raffit Hassan, 2021) – grow in R10; split 1/2 twice per week.

steps.title: Maintain sarcomatoid mesothelioma
steps.instruction: Culture each sarcomatoid mesothelioma line as indicated and split at the given ratio and frequency.

substeps.instruction: NCI‑H2691 (RRID:CVCL_A551) – culture in R10 (no split ratio provided).
NCI‑H2373 (RRID:CVCL_A533) – grow in R10; split 1/5 twice per week.
NCI‑H2373‑GFP/luciferase (gift of Manish Patel) – grow in R10; split 1/5 twice per week; maintain with blasticidin 2 µg/mL.

steps.title: Maintain triple‑negative breast line
steps.instruction: Culture MDA‑MB‑231 in D10, treat with trypsin as specified, and split at the indicated ratio and frequency.

substeps.instruction: MDA‑MB‑231 (RRID:CVCL_0062; ATCC, Aug 2021) – grow in D10; when subculturing, treat with 0.25 % trypsin for 1–2 min only, then split 1/10 three times per week.

steps.title: Maintain endometrial adenocarcinoma
steps.instruction: Maintain the two Ishikawa sub‑lines; no specific culture parameters were provided.

substeps.instruction: Ishikawa 3‑H‑12 (same as ECC‑1) – sensitive line; culture conditions not specified.
Ishikawa 3‑H‑12 (same as ECC‑1) – resistant line; culture conditions not specified.

steps.title: Maintain castration‑resistant prostate lines
steps.instruction: Culture each CRPC line in the indicated medium and use the specified trypsin concentration for harvest; note hypoxia‑adapted variants.

substeps.instruction: LnCAP (RRID:CVCL_0395) – grow in R10; harvest cells with 0.2 % trypsin.
C4‑2 (starred) – grow in R10 (no split ratio or trypsin detail provided).
C4‑2B (gift of Xcell Biosciences) – grow in R10 (no split ratio provided).
C4‑2B hypoxia‑adapted (gift of Xcell Biosciences) – maintain under hypoxic conditions; other parameters as for C4‑2B.
PC3 (gift of Xcell Biosciences) – grow in R10 (no split ratio provided).
PC3 hypoxia‑adapted (gift of Xcell Biosciences) – maintain under hypoxic conditions; other parameters as for PC3.
PC3‑NuclightRed (gift of Scott Dehm) – grow in R10 (no split ratio provided).

steps.title: Maintain ovarian cancer lines
steps.instruction: Culture each ovarian cancer line as indicated, noting seeding densities and trypsin use where given.

substeps.instruction: OVCAR3 (RRID:CVCL_0465; NCI, received Mar 2017) – grow in R10 (no split ratio provided).
OVCAR4 (RRID:CVCL_1627; NCI, received Mar 2017) – grow in R10 (no split ratio provided).
OVCAR5 (RRID:CVCL_1628; NCI, received Mar 2017) – grow in R10 (no split ratio provided).
OVCAR8 (RRID:CVCL_1629; NCI, received Mar 2017) – grow in R10; when subculturing, seed at 11,000 cells / cm².
OVCAR8‑Nuclight Red (made 2018 by Laura Bendzick & Caitlin Ryan) – maintain as OVCAR8; no additional parameters.
SK‑OV‑3 (RRID:CVCL_0532; NCI, received Mar 2017) – grow in R10 (no split ratio provided).
OV‑90 (RRID:CVCL_3768; ATCC, received Aug 2024) – grow in R10; seed at least 1 × 10⁶ cells per 75 cm²; harvest with 0.25 % trypsin 2–3 times per week.

steps.title: Maintain brain tumor and other lines
steps.instruction: Culture each listed line in the indicated medium; follow external subculture protocol for LN229.

substeps.instruction: BT12 (gift of Crystal Mackall) – grow in D10 with Glutamax; split ratio not specified.
BT12 B7H3‑knockout (gift of Crystal Mackall) – same conditions as BT12; no additional parameters.
BT16 (RRID:CVCL_M156; atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor) – grow in D10‑Glut; split ratio not specified.
LN229 (ATCC, received Dec 2023) – grow in D10; refer to ATCC subculture protocol https://www.atcc.org/products/crl-2611 for detailed steps.
SK‑Mel‑3 (purchased from ATCC, 2022) – culture conditions not specified.
CHL‑2 (purchased from ATCC, 2022) – culture conditions not specified.
